svg.title: The demo story, step by step
svg.desc: Timeline of the changes the demo fakes play on request, on the fake clock: first syncs on 28 September; on GitHub the payments-api repository is renamed (1 Oct) and its CODEOWNERS moves from payments to platform (2 Oct), sre is renamed Reliability (3 Oct) and legacy-ops is deleted (5 Oct); in Kubernetes payments-api scales to 3 replicas and moves to image 1.4.2 (6 Oct), billing-core loses its team label (7 Oct), payments-api's repository annotation becomes TODO (8 Oct), billing-api drops LEDGER_URL and legacy-billing is deleted (9 Oct); in the directory Lena Fischer's engineering membership ends on 1 November with no event.

g.text: THE FAKE CLOCK · UTC · ONE DAY = ONE TICK

g.aria-label: 0. SEP 28 · 01:30: first syncs, GitHub, directory and cluster read in full
1. OCT 1 · 12:00: repo-rename, payments-api renamed to payments
2. OCT 2 · 08:30: codeowners-move, CODEOWNERS moves from @acme/payments to platform
3. OCT 3 · 10:00: team-rename, sre renamed Reliability; handbook still names sre
4. OCT 5 · 15:00: team-delete, legacy-ops deleted; ops-scripts still names it
5. OCT 6 · 09:30: replicas, payments-api scaled from 2 to 3 replicas
6. OCT 6 · 14:10: image, payments-api image 1.4.1 → 1.4.2
7. OCT 7 · 10:00: team-label, billing-core's team label set to empty
8. OCT 8 · 11:00: annotation, payments-api's repo annotation becomes TODO
9. OCT 9 · 12:00: dependency, billing-api drops LEDGER_URL
10. OCT 9 · 16:00: workload-delete, legacy-billing Deployment deleted
11. NOV 1 · 00:00: membership-end, Lena Fischer leaves engineering; no event

g.text: Step card: what changes, and what Bearing then answers
